testTypeDescriptions.memory: Allocates and releases large memory buffers to test Node.js heap management and garbage collection performance, capped at 500MB.
testTypeDescriptions.cpu: Generates CPU-intensive load via cryptographic operations (PBKDF2), testing event loop latency under heavy computation.
testTypeDescriptions.mixed: Combined load (60% database + 20% API + 10% memory + 10% CPU), simulating real production mixed-request scenarios.

common.title: Data Use Notice
common.summary: Before continuing, please review briefly how CoBook handles the data you provide.

feedbackCreate.title: Before submitting a ticket
feedbackCreate.summary: The title, description, and context you enter in a ticket will be used by support to investigate; we use this information only as needed to resolve the issue.
feedbackCreate.dataValue: Ticket title, description, selected category, and your account ID (so we can reply to you)
feedbackCreate.processorValue: YouTrack support system (JetBrains s.r.o., EU GDPR DPA signed)
feedbackCreate.retentionValue: Retained after the ticket is closed for review; automatically archived/deleted when retention expires or compliance requires it
feedbackCreate.sharingValue: Never sold; disclosed only when legally required or with your authorization

helpdeskAttachment.title: Before uploading attachments
helpdeskAttachment.summary: Attachments may contain screenshots, documents, or personal information. Please avoid uploading sensitive data unrelated to the issue; you may request deletion or restriction at any time.
helpdeskAttachment.dataLabel: Data you are about to upload
helpdeskAttachment.dataValue: Image or PDF file content (including all information visible in it)
helpdeskAttachment.processorValue: AWS S3 (EU region) + CloudFront CDN + YouTrack support system
helpdeskAttachment.retentionValue: Retained for the ticket's lifecycle; drafts unsent for 30 days are auto-cleaned; deletion requests are hard-deleted after 7 days
helpdeskAttachment.sharingValue: Accessible only to authorized support staff; deletions are paused during compliance holds (GDPR Article 18)

onboarding.title: Welcome to CoBook — Data Use Notice
onboarding.summary: Before continuing, please review briefly how CoBook handles the data you generate in the app; continuing means you have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
onboarding.dataLabel: Data categories involved in the app
onboarding.dataValue: Account information, content (products/reviews/messages), device ID, action logs, and location/camera/photo library you authorize
onboarding.controllerValue: CoBook (the operator); address and DPO contact in the Privacy Policy
onboarding.processorValue: AWS (EU region storage and CDN), Firebase (push), Sentry (crash logs), etc. — all with signed GDPR DPAs
onboarding.retentionValue: Retained while the account is active; after deletion, archived/anonymized per legal retention periods
onboarding.sharingValue: Never sold; disclosed only when legally required or with your authorization

accountCreation.title: Before creating an account
accountCreation.summary: Account creation involves processing your personal information. Continuing constitutes consent to use of this data as described below.
accountCreation.dataValue: Username, password (hash only), linked email and social account IDs, and device identification information
accountCreation.processorValue: Apple Sign In / Google OAuth (auth callbacks only), AWS (account database)
accountCreation.retentionValue: Retained while the account exists; after deletion, archived/anonymized per legal retention periods
accountCreation.sharingValue: Never sold; disclosed only when legally required or with your authorization

providerOnboarding.title: Merchant onboarding — notice on credentials and personal information
providerOnboarding.summary: Submitting an onboarding application involves sensitive credential information of the legal representative/operator. Please upload only application-related materials; the information will be reviewed by the platform compliance team.
providerOnboarding.dataValue: Merchant name/address/contact info, business license, representative ID, storefront photos, and applicant account
providerOnboarding.processorValue: AWS S3 (EU region, encrypted storage) + CloudFront CDN (originals accessible only to authorized reviewers)
providerOnboarding.retentionValue: Retained during review; kept with the merchant profile if approved; rejections are soft-deleted after 30 days and hard-deleted after another 7 days
providerOnboarding.sharingValue: Visible only to platform compliance reviewers; not disclosed to third parties except as legally required or under judicial cooperation

secondhandPublish.title: Before publishing a product
secondhandPublish.summary: The title, description, and photos you publish will be displayed publicly to all users. Do not upload information that can identify others (faces, ID numbers, addresses, etc.).
secondhandPublish.dataLabel: Data you are about to publish
secondhandPublish.dataValue: Product title, description, price, category, photos (including all information visible in them)
secondhandPublish.processorValue: AWS S3 (EU region) + CloudFront CDN (public image cache)
secondhandPublish.retentionValue: Kept 30 days after delisting for dispute handling; then soft-deleted + hard-deleted after 7 more days; location data is stripped from EXIF
secondhandPublish.sharingValue: Published publicly to all app users; never sold to third-party marketing

trustedDevice.title: Remember this device — data usage
trustedDevice.summary: Ticking "Remember this device" consents to CoBook storing a stable device identifier so this device can skip 2FA prompts and suppress new-device login emails.
trustedDevice.dataValue: Browser: cobook_device_id (HttpOnly cookie, 2-year expiry). Mobile app: DeviceInfo.getUniqueId() reported via the X-Device-Id header. Linked only to your account ID; never exported to third parties.
trustedDevice.processorValue: AWS RDS (EU region, encrypted at rest)
trustedDevice.retentionValue: Permanent trust until you revoke it from Active sessions, or until the device sits idle for 360 days (auto-revoked). Legal basis: GDPR Art 6(1)(f) legitimate interest — account security.
trustedDevice.sharingValue: Not sold; used internally only for 2FA bypass decisions and new-device alert suppression.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Add an extra layer of protection when signing in
twoFactor.introTitle: Secure your account with an authenticator app
twoFactor.introBody: Once enabled, every sign-in will require both your password and a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, etc.). This makes account takeover much harder.
twoFactor.scanQRInstruction: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app. If you can't scan, enter the secret key manually.
twoFactor.verifyCodeHint: Enter the 6-digit code currently shown in your authenticator app
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can use one of the codes below to sign in. Each code can only be used once. Copy or screenshot them now — they will not be shown again.
twoFactor.savedConfirmCheckbox: I have saved my backup codes
twoFactor.rememberDeviceHintBody: On the next login, tick "Remember this device" to permanently skip the verification code. You can untrust devices anytime from Active sessions.
twoFactor.disableConfirmMessage: Your account will only be protected by your password. Are you sure?
twoFactor.regenerateConfirmMessage: All existing backup codes will be invalidated. Save the new ones carefully.
twoFactor.loginPromptSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or use a 10-character backup code.
twoFactor.disableStepUpBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a 10-character backup code, to confirm it's really you.
twoFactor.regenerateStepUpTitle: Verify it's you to regenerate backup codes
twoFactor.regenerateStepUpBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a 10-character backup code. Once confirmed, your old backup codes are invalidated immediately and the new ones will appear.
twoFactor.stepUpInputHint: 6-digit TOTP or 10-character backup code (case-insensitive, dash optional)

sessions.logoutThisDeviceConfirmMessage: Sign out of this account on this device?
sessions.revokeSessionConfirmMessage: This device will be signed out of the account.
sessions.revokeAllOthersConfirmMessage: Keeps the current device, revokes all others.
sessions.knownDevicesSubtitle: Browsers or phones where you ticked "Remember this device". These skip the 2FA prompt on future logins.
sessions.knownDeviceRevokeConfirmMessage: {{device}} will be signed out immediately and treated as a stranger next login: full 2FA prompt + re-tick "Remember this device" required.
